“For the treasure,” he admitted brazenly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0076", "tag": "p", "text": "“But it is written in the Book of Life that I shall marry Francis,” she objected.", "sha256": "02d6b30608ae059a44971e1282e53c0b0822ec8ad5d1f8c10a2f32cbad99c31a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1838]", "source_html": "

“But it is written in the Book of Life that I shall marry Francis,” she objected.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0077", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then will we rewrite that page in the Book of Life.”", "sha256": "3ba974ddac18fd378a440d7c798f4d5c47d9627811dbbcccc5cf8929d078955c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1839]", "source_html": "

“Then will we rewrite that page in the Book of Life.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0078", "tag": "p", "text": "“As if it could be done!” she laughed.", "sha256": "b69e8854579ddb198473d16b3ea2b086abe205a86e64f67608a0ea53f9a08ce5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1840]", "source_html": "
